newsitem.title: USA: Tennessee sees natgas station up Weds night.
newsitem.headline: Tennessee sees natgas station up Weds night.

text.p: Tenneco unit Tennessee Gas Pipeline said its DeKalb, Miss., natural gas compressor station should return to operation Wednesday night following valve repairs.
Due to the repairs, Tennessee has been rerouting about 200 million cubic feet per day on its 500 line.

"Until the repairs are complete, Tennessee will continue to meet its transportation commitments by rerouting about 200 mmcf/day of natural gas from nearby interconnects," the company said in a statement.
Tennessee said no customer deliveries have been affected by the outage.
The valve failed Tuesday night, causing the station to be shut down.
